sloka: स्वर्गो अस्तु स शरीरस्य त्रिशंकोः अस्य शाश्वतः ।नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि मामकानि ध्रुवाणि अथ ॥१-६०-२८॥
transliteration: svargo astu sa śarīrasya triśaṁkoḥ asya śāśvataḥ ।nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi māmakāni dhruvāṇi atha ॥1-60-28॥

translations.english: Let this heaven be an eternal abode for Trisanku in his physical form All these stars created by me shall endure as long as the worlds survive. O gods it behoves of you to accord consent to this".
